cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Outdo the Effort
cards.instruction: Answer every favor, chore, or sacrifice with a bigger one that restores your lead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You brought soup? I'll prepare your dinners for a week. Label portions by date, please; guessing isn't meal planning.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're ill. I've already filled your freezer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then when I'm up, I'll fill yours for a month. Properly portioned; we won't waste your space on half-empty tubs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine's tiny. Just return the tubs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Measure the alcove for me, width and depth. I'll return them full inside a freezer that fits. Both measurements, please; I don't order appliances by hope.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 dated portions and A3 storage correction make generosity competitive through expertise; A5 appliance measurement extends the same role.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 full freezer causes A3 month of meals; B4 small freezer causes A5 larger appliance, but an alcove is assumed without setup.

relationship.evidence: B2 cares for illness and B4 requests only returned containers, which A escalates beyond.

heightening.evidence: A5 takes B4 practical capacity limit as a reason for a much larger return gift.

specificity.evidence: A1 soup and B2 illness are clear; A5 alcove and only two dimensions are unnecessary physical assumptions.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 hope remark adds a maxim after the needed request and gift.

coach2.inferred: A cannot accept being outgiven and uses competent planning to enlarge repayment.
coach2.missing: No alcove needs to be invented; A can simply request dimensions for a larger appliance.
coach2.firstDefect: A5 assumes an alcove and overexplains the professional measurement request.
